_about: 4-21 (step 133; re-flown for the wall's speed gate, planning step 175, in the route phase of wave 4c-2, round 1).
rolling_stone_1759 (32, 144) is destroyable, and breakable_wall_1751 (x 371 to 497, y 139 to 169), which covers
button_1723, now breaks only for a stone above 1.5 m/s at its first touch, and kills the stone with it (WALL). The old
route set the stone down above the wall and it fell on it at 0.47: held. The gravity agent (460, 36) pulls at most 1.5 x
gravity at the owner's 60 Hz, so it beats gravity only inside about 190 units of it: a stone set down above the wall is
lifted away from it, and the stone can only get fast against the wall from UNDER it. The only place with a line into the
pit under the wall is the lower platform (a shot from the spawn platform's end meets the wall's top), so he walks left off
the spawn platform (5-38; crystals (128, 96) on 17 and (96, 144) on 35) and lands on the lower platform at x 95.4 on 45.
Tap 1 (50, at (395, 199.5)) opens the exit portal in the pit on 138, 32 units under the wall: the stone set down there
at rest has its top 3 units under the wall's underside, and the well pulls it right along it (about a third of the pull
is sideways), so it touches the wall on 184 at 1.94 m/s - the callback reads the WHOLE velocity, and the touch is
sideways - and the wall breaks and the stone dies. He walks to x 155 (56-80; the crystal at (160, 192) on 74) and tap 2
(144, at (70, 146)) opens the entry beside the stone on 168; it must come AFTER the exit, for a stone that sleeps in a
portal that stood before its partner does not go. The stone is out at the exit on 168. He walks on to x 246.6 (145-182:
tap 3's view must reach x 465, which needs the camera at 238 or more, and the lower platform ends at 256, where he falls).
Tap 3 (190, at (465, 150)) opens a portal over the bared button on 254, a shot after the wall has gone (184), and tap 4
(256, on himself, 2 ticks after it lands) puts him out of it on 258: the crystal at (480, 152) on 259 and the button
pressed on landing (door_lift_1721 opens on 258). Right held from 262 he presses on the door's face from 273, drifts under
it once its bottom clears his head, and reaches the exit on tick 360. Four of the five crystals, medal 2, 4 portals, no
achievement (as the old route). EXCEPTIONAL: a KNIFE-EDGE. The stone's first touch must come fast, and a stone set
down a little lower touches the wall late and slowly and the wall holds (aim (395, 200.8): 0.54 m/s). The exit's aim wins
for y 198.5 to 200.5 at x 395 and for x 392 to 401 at y 199.5, a band that slides right as y rises (speeds 1.5 to 2.2);
edges: tap 1 holds 5 ticks early and 16 late, tap 2 5 early and 4 late, tap 3 4 early and 3 late (tap 4 waits for its
landing), tap 4 3 early and 12 late, the first walk 5 early and 6 late, the second walk's end 2 either way (x 241.8 to
251.4). Leans on the wall's gate (demolish.json), the well's pull (gravitywell.json), the spent pair, and R23's ray.
